Primary sources were manufacturer/authoritative product pages (sonos.com, bose.com, lg.com, denon.com, samsung.com, dolby.com) plus rtings.com and review articles from digitaltrends.com, techradar.com, whathifi.com, ecoustics.com, and tomsguide.com. Verification pass (2026-06-15) corrected several values: Samsung HW-Q990D priceUsd corrected to $1,999.99 (from an erroneous $1,299) per Samsung.com / Best Buy / Crutchfield, and its dts_x corrected to true (What Hi-Fi, RTINGS, TechRadar confirm DTS:X). LG S95TR release year corrected to 2024 (from 2023) per RTINGS/Best Buy/Amazon; $1,599.99 MSRP confirmed on LG.com. Sony Bravia Theatre Bar 9 channels corrected to 5.0.2 (from a fabricated 7.0.4) and total_watts set to 585 per Dolby's official spec page and ecoustics. Bose Smart Ultra priceUsd corrected to $899 launch MSRP (later raised to $999).
